calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, sum(gross_amount) gross,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
 sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) negs
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.store_id=900 is_web, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, count(*) n, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-20' AND DATE '2024-10-10' GROUP BY ALL

SELECT o.status, count(*) lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order, sum(CASE WHEN o.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp,
 min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmin, max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) dmax,
 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff_date
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-15' AND DATE '2024-10-15' GROUP BY ALL

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.region, s.store_id, p.category, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount, f.sales_line_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
)
SELECT region,
 SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN gross_amount END) aug,
 SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN gross_amount END) sep,
 SUM(CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND (store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test') THEN gross_amount END) excluded,
 count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) - count(*) dupchk
FROM lines
WHERE NOT (store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test')
GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

WITH web_dispatch AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.category, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(net_amount) net FROM lines
  WHERE store_id<>999 AND category<>'ZZ Test' AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales_before_returns n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<>999)
SELECT count(*) cells, sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(m.net,0)-coalesce(c.n,0))>0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diffs,
 sum(m.net) mine, sum(c.n) ctl,
 (SELECT sum(gross_amount) FROM lines WHERE (store_id=999 OR category='ZZ Test') AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30') excluded_gross
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.business_date=m.business_date AND c.store_id=m.store_id
